subject: Across 214,000 older adults, dementia risk factors varied by country
script: From Agewell Brief: Across 214,000 older adults, dementia risk factors varied by country. A new global analysis of more than 214,000 older adults reveals that dementia risk factors vary widely by country, but some patterns are surprisingly consistent. For decades, most research on dementia prevention has come from high-income countries like the U.S. and Western Europe. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
